title: Reuben, Gad and Manasseh: The War against the Hagrites
description: The Transjordanian tribes of Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh win a great victory over the Hagrites because they cry out to God and trust in him. Later they become unfaithful and practice idolatry, so God allows the Assyrian kings Pul and Tiglath-Pileser to carry them away into captivity.
